-- class: contract
-- name: public

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-table
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create table "public"."notes" (
  "body" text not null,
  "id" integer not null,
  "ownerId" uuid not null,
  constraint "notes_pkey" primary key ("id")
);

-- class: expand
-- kind: enable-rls
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter table "public"."notes" enable row level security;

-- class: contract
-- kind: policy-public
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create policy "open" on "public"."notes" as permissive for all to public using (true);
